versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the LayerBack Image to VSDX skill.
- Convert diagram images (PNG, JPEG, WebP) to fully editable Visio VSDX files using the official LayerBack web app and API.
- Supports flowcharts, architecture diagrams, UML, ER diagrams, org charts, network diagrams, screenshots, and whiteboard photos.
- Provides both API and web-based conversion options, with clear credit usage and security practices.
- Includes detailed workflow, API usage, and setup instructions for users.
